description:
## Goal

src/favicon_storage.cr @client_pool is a Hash(String, HTTP::Client)
keyed by host. Each unique feed host adds a client (with its own
socket pool / TLS context) that is never removed. With many
distinct feed sources the pool grows unbounded and each client
holds a live socket.

## Approach

1. Add a MAX_CLIENT_POOL_SIZE constant (start with 32, configurable
   via QuickHeadlines::Constants).
2. On insert, if size >= MAX, close and evict the oldest entry
   (use the same access-order / shift pattern as FaviconCache in
   src/favicon_cache.cr).
3. Also evict on error path (fetch_http rescue already deletes
   the pool key; verify close is called on the dropped client).
4. Add a getter `client_pool_size` to expose this in the memory
   log.

## Acceptance

- Pool never exceeds MAX_CLIENT_POOL_SIZE.
- Oldest client is closed (and the underlying socket released)
  on eviction.
- New getter surfaces in the memory report (cf. task 1).
- Build + spec + ameba clean.
title: Cap and LRU-evict FaviconActor @client_pool
